## Design

### 2026-10-07 – October 06

**10h**

October 06

Started brainstorming - great ideas in the makings! Thought of a screen with a quote in the middle, and with the date, time and years since the Big Bang and formation of the Solar System.

Duration - 2hrs

October 07

Great progress! Literally finished the crux of it. I have done the main items, like the schematics, the BOM, layout of the screen and everything else regarding the planning stage. Images attached. This is seriously a prime lock in. I have gotten all the details for this stuff taking inspiration from my CanSat boards and electronics. This is going to be a great project!

I am already planning the KiCad stuff, as my third photo shows. I have been taking a lot of knowledge from past things to do this, like the ESP-32 selection and stuff. I am great at OnShape so am looking forward to that once I've finished more brainstorming. (P.S. I even made a folder for this in my OneDrive!!)

Also, the SSS is the e-screen and SSSsss is the ultra-thin real-time clock for me to access that data. I am going to have it as thin as possible, with probable dimensions as 4.8cm X 3.2cm including the glass borders but excluding the frame case I will make customisable with the logo of 'The Astronomy Files', which is also attached.

I also added an image to show what the PCB and soldered circuit may look like. I hope it is much smaller and thinner though!
